versions.content: DL field Incoming FF - I frames with DL = 0x000 shall be ignored. Moreover , if the DL value is lower than the possible (from the PDU size, the addressing type and the channel specific Long Messages switch derivable) payload of a SF, the frame shall also be ignored. If acknowledgment is configured, in all the cases above additionally an AF with a negative acknowledgement shall be sent back to the sender.
